name: Comparatives & superlatives
note: Short adjectives: -er / -est (cheap → cheaper → the cheapest). Longer adjectives: more / the most (expensive → more expensive). Use than after a comparative, and the before a superlative. Irregular: good → better → best; bad → worse → worst.

questions.q: Life in a country is ______ in a city.
Mike: More people die from eating fatty food than from smoking. Jane: ______
questions.fs: Mike: More people die from eating fatty food than from smoking. Jane: You must be joking!

questions.q: Is her ______ than mine?
Apparently Betty is jealous ______ I get better grades than she does.
I think he'll succeed but it's a lot of work and sometimes he feels he's bitten off more than he can ______
questions.fs: I think he'll succeed but it's a lot of work and sometimes he feels he's bitten off more than he can chew.

questions.q: I've got ______ pencils than you.
Tom works the ______ of anyone.
questions.fs: Tom works the hardest of anyone.

questions.q: At least that was ______ to be the background although the main interest was in something else.
questions.fs: At least that was supposed to be the background although the main interest was in something else.

questions.q: She dressed the child in a heavy overcoat, ______ he should catch cold.
Many people have been made redundant in the takeover and those who joined last were the first to go. The principle of devil take the ______ applied.
questions.fs: Many people have been made redundant in the takeover and those who joined last were the first to go. The principle of devil take the hindmost applied.

questions.q: New houses are ______ than old ones.
I'm worried about her because she ______ more pills than usual.
questions.fs: I'm worried about her because she is taking more pills than usual.

questions.q: The ______ on your camera may not be able to light the entire subject at distances of less than 40 centimeters.
questions.fs: The flash on your camera may not be able to light the entire subject at distances of less than 40 centimeters.

questions.q: Many people want to ______ from their native countries to other nations. However, nowadays, it's much more difficult than it was in the past.
questions.fs: Many people want to emigrate from their native countries to other nations. However, nowadays, it's much more difficult than it was in the past.

questions.q: These exercises are ______ in the exam.
I like pencils ______ than pens.
questions.fs: I like pencils better than pens.

questions.q: Mary E. Outerbridge ______ the first tennis court in New York City in 1874.
questions.fs: Mary E. Outerbridge established the first tennis court in New York City in 1874.

questions.q: There is a new company regulation to remove the danger of passive smoking, which ______ all employees from smoking at their place of work.
questions.fs: There is a new company regulation to remove the danger of passive smoking, which prohibits all employees from smoking at their place of work.

questions.q: Your class is ______ than my class.
My old job was ______ than this one.
questions.fs: My old job was easier than this one.

questions.q: ______ people came than I expected.
It is much easier to ______ an illness than it is to cure it.
questions.fs: It is much easier to prevent an illness than it is to cure it.

questions.q: Your essay was ______ than Jim's, but it was ______ than Mary's.
Driving to work in a car is much ______ than riding a bicycle.
questions.fs: Driving to work in a car is much faster than riding a bicycle.

questions.q: Spanish people usually speak ______ than English people.
He has a very refined vocabulary and prefers to use a ______ rather than a more common and vulgar word.
questions.fs: He has a very refined vocabulary and prefers to use a euphemism rather than a more common and vulgar word.

questions.q: Do you have ______ homework?
Perth offers an eclectic ______ within the breathtaking backdrop of grassy parks, towering palm trees and endless waterways.
questions.fs: Perth offers an eclectic lifestyle within the breathtaking backdrop of grassy parks, towering palm trees and endless waterways.

questions.q: We often hear that such and such a piece of information cannot be released into the public ______ in the interest of national security.
questions.fs: We often hear that such and such a piece of information cannot be released into the public domain in the interest of national security.

questions.q: The house is 50 meters ______ the sea.
These are indeed ______ times for the government as people are deciding whether to vote for them in the next election.
questions.fs: These are indeed testing times for the government as people are deciding whether to vote for them in the next election.

questions.q: If you want to get the best out of your sales force, they must believe in the product and be ______ enough to promote it vigorously.
questions.fs: If you want to get the best out of your sales force, they must believe in the product and be inspired enough to promote it vigorously.

questions.q: Brain's car is ______ in our district.
Researchers are also looking into the possibility of one day launching a manned ______ to Mars.
questions.fs: Researchers are also looking into the possibility of one day launching a manned mission to Mars.

questions.q: Personally I find that although the taste of your lunch is important, it should also look ______ on the plate.
questions.fs: Personally I find that although the taste of your lunch is important, it should also look elegant on the plate.

questions.q: A city is ______ than the country.
The world's ______ pizzeria opened in Naples in 1830.
questions.fs: The world's first pizzeria opened in Naples in 1830.

questions.q: But if you have no ______ at all, the best thing is to drop off or nod off in the middle of the conversation.
questions.fs: But if you have no inhibitions at all, the best thing is to drop off or nod off in the middle of the conversation.

questions.q: I've got a book ______ Mark Twain.
It goes without ______ that there are more goals that can be achieved with your business than simply generating revenue.
questions.fs: It goes without saying that there are more goals that can be achieved with your business than simply generating revenue.

questions.q: The whole purpose of all these exercises is to ______ your knowledge of grammar and vocabulary.
questions.fs: The whole purpose of all these exercises is to test your knowledge of grammar and vocabulary.

questions.q: Claridge's is the ______ hotel.
Adelaide is ______ in Southern Australia and is the quintessential picture of charm with its colonial architecture.
questions.fs: Adelaide is located in Southern Australia and is the quintessential picture of charm with its colonial architecture.

questions.q: There was very strong support for the police who were determined to ______ this kind of crime.
questions.fs: There was very strong support for the police who were determined to curb this kind of crime.

questions.q: Bill ______ got any friends.
I ______ have coffee than tea.
The widow spent more than two days writing a loving and appropriate ______ to put on her beloved husband's headstone.
questions.fs: The widow spent more than two days writing a loving and appropriate epitaph to put on her beloved husband's headstone.

questions.q: This exercise is ______ difficult in the book.
______ charges are high and cause a lot of problems for people who write checks for more than they have in their account.
questions.fs: NSF (non-sufficient funds) charges are high and cause a lot of problems for people who write checks for more than they have in their account.

questions.q: The telephone connection was very poor and we only heard a ______ account of what the reporter was describing.
questions.fs: The telephone connection was very poor and we only heard a garbled account of what the reporter was describing.

questions.q: He spends his time ______ the banks of the river.
Environmentalists around the world fight to preserve the world's natural beauty and resources for future generations. What is an antonym of 'preserve'? ______
questions.fs: Environmentalists around the world fight to preserve the world's natural beauty and resources for future generations. What is an antonym of 'preserve'? destroy

questions.q: Yesterday was ______ than today.
When a writer makes something out to be more than it is, it's called a(n) ______
questions.fs: When a writer makes something out to be more than it is, it's called a(n) exaggeration.

questions.q: The Plaza is the ______ hotel.
Australia is roughly the same ______ as the United States but with less than a tenth of the people.
questions.fs: Australia is roughly the same size as the United States but with less than a tenth of the people.

questions.q: My parents ______ a new stereo.
He ______ live in the country than in the city.
Why did you leave London? You had a ______ job.
Everything is so much bigger than you expect and you are constantly ______ your head from side to side.
questions.fs: Everything is so much bigger than you expect and you are constantly turning your head from side to side.

questions.q: Prague is one of the ______ cities in Europe,
The restaurant was listed in the guide as it had been ______ to be of the appropriate standard.
questions.fs: The restaurant was listed in the guide as it had been judged to be of the appropriate standard.

questions.q: He jumped ______ the lake.

Jane: How many people were at Brad's wedding? Bruce: Oh, there must have been at least 150 people there. The reception hall was really big, and it was nearly full of guests. We had a great time. Jane: That's great. Question: How many people were at Brad's wedding? ______
questions.fs: Jane: How many people were at Brad's wedding? Bruce: Oh, there must have been at least 150 people there. The reception hall was really big, and it was nearly full of guests. We had a great time. Jane: That's great. Question: How many people were at Brad's wedding? About 150 people.

questions.q: A country is quieter ______ a city.
After a while I got fed up with the film and began to lose ______ in the story.
questions.fs: After a while I got fed up with the film and began to lose interest in the story.

questions.q: She is taller ______ her elder sister.
We would like to ______ our customers that over the Christmas period we will be closing an hour earlier than usual.
questions.fs: We would like to remind our customers that over the Christmas period we will be closing an hour earlier than usual.

questions.q: New York is ______ Paris.
Most people like the ______ of not having to work.
questions.fs: Most people like the idea of not having to work.

questions.q: Have you ______ any rice?
I sometimes find that the ______ made by the advertisers are more interesting than the actual television programmes themselves.
questions.fs: I sometimes find that the commercials made by the advertisers are more interesting than the actual television programmes themselves.

questions.q: Does your sister ______ a fiancé?
At the end of the race the tortoise, ______ by all his hard work, was quietly slumbering on the line.
questions.fs: At the end of the race the tortoise, exhausted by all his hard work, was quietly slumbering on the line.

questions.q: Yesterday it was ______ the day before yesterday.
Today's youth is far more disorderly and ______ than in the past, and it is not just a minority but the vast majority.
questions.fs: Today's youth is far more disorderly and ill mannered than in the past, and it is not just a minority but the vast majority.

questions.q: Maya ______ got a camera. And she ______ have a car either.
The world has suffered more from the ravages of ______ marriages than from virginity.
questions.fs: The world has suffered more from the ravages of ill-advised marriages than from virginity.

questions.q: She came ______ the garage.
Perth is the most western town of Australia and holds the ______ of having more sun-filled hours than most of Australia's other capital cities.
questions.fs: Perth is the most western town of Australia and holds the distinction of having more sun-filled hours than most of Australia's other capital cities.

questions.q: Nancy's car is ______ than mine, but Ben's car is ______ car.
Usually Saturday and Sunday just ______ by more quickly than the other 5 days of the week.
questions.fs: Usually Saturday and Sunday just fly by more quickly than the other 5 days of the week.

questions.q: A: ______ they got any problems? B: No, they ______ .
Why is there ______ traffic on the streets in February than in May?
Our school ______ a library, but it doesn't ______ any computers.
I have never been ______ more beautiful than Thailand.
questions.fs: I have never been anywhere more beautiful than Thailand.

questions.q: Madrid is much ______ .
After all as far as she was concerned the cruise was going to be a journey of a ______
questions.fs: After all as far as she was concerned the cruise was going to be a journey of a lifetime.

questions.q: Last week was ______ than this week.
The subject ______ of the film concerned the American Civil War in the 1860's.
questions.fs: The subject matter of the film concerned the American Civil War in the 1860's.
